title: The Founding Miners' Statute
logline: Aging asteroid drillers invoke a fifty-year-old frontier charter to declare sovereignty over an asteroid basin just as a transit conglomerate arrives to build a regional jump gate.

roles.description: Representative of the pioneer drilling generation; stooped, harsh-voiced, clutching an antique bronze sovereignty seal.
Inter-system transit executive; sharp, dismissive, authorized to buy out or bulldoze ancient frontier claims.
A heavy corporate picket cruiser blockading the mineral basin to enforce construction permits.
The loose brotherhood of retired prospectors who settled the asteroid belts fifty cycles ago.
A mega-syndicate constructing regional jump gates across newly opened trade corridors.
An excavated asteroid habitat where hundreds of aging mining families live on dwindling ore veins.
A remote administrative repository in an adjacent system holding original sector colonization charters.
A deep-space judicial concourse in an administrative capital system where territorial disputes are heard.

public_situation: Tensions rise as {role:transit_consortium} survey ships are turned away from {role:pioneer_hollow} by elderly asteroid drillers wielding a historic charter.
private_truth: The charter's fifty-year-old boundary survey used an obsolete stellar datum that inadvertently grants the miners legal ownership of the entire inter-system jump corridor.

beats.public_change: Construction beacons around {role:pioneer_hollow} are dismantled by miners as the pioneer council issues a formal notice of sovereignty.

missions.reason: Mine and deliver high-grade thorium ore to sustain the aging habitat's backup reactor during the pending transit blockade.
missions.private_fact: The habitat life-support systems have less than forty days of reactor fuel remaining before life support fails.

beats.public_change: Corporate bailiffs obtain an injunction in a neighbouring system to freeze pioneer bank accounts and impound supply haulers.

missions.reason: Retrieve the signed brass territorial covenant cylinder from the regional archival vault before corporate attorneys seal the records.
missions.private_fact: The original charter granted miners sovereign status in exchange for dying of radiation while blasting the primary planetary access gates.

beats.public_change: Cartographers reading the charter cylinder discover its coordinate datum covers the exact jump gate singularity site.

missions.reason: Scan the historic colonial triangulation beacons to verify that the pioneer boundary coordinates encompass the new jump lane.
missions.private_fact: The conglomerate envoy knew the charter covered the jump corridor and suppressed the survey to avoid paying transit royalties.

beats.public_change: The corporate gunship moves into firing position over {role:regional_adjudication_dock} to intercept the evidence.

missions.reason: The corporate gunship intercepts the pilot in orbit; engage the vessel to force a passage to the arbitral dock.
missions.private_fact: The gunship captain hails mid-battle offering seventy-five thousand credits and a corporate freight license if the pilot drops the charter.

missions.reason: Deliver the charter cylinder and triangulation data to the chief colonial magistrate before the building permit becomes irrevocable.
missions.private_fact: The chairperson knows this is the last legal campaign he will ever live to contest.

player_choice.prompt: The charter is tabled before the magistrate. The pioneer miners have absolute legal title over the system's most lucrative future jump lane.

options.label: Demand full legal enforcement of pioneer sovereignty, granting miners the right to toll all inter-system gate traffic
Broker a perpetual dividend compact granting every pioneer retiree guaranteed pensions and medical care in exchange for gate rights
Accept the conglomerate's buyout and suppress the ancient charter datum to accelerate trade expansion

resolutions.reached_by: The magistrate validates the ancient charter, granting the miners sovereign territory over the jump route.
resolutions.summary: The court upholds the pioneer charter. {role:pioneer_league} claims sovereign ownership of the gate corridor, levying heavy tolls on {role:transit_consortium}.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot carried a fifty-year brass charter to court, winning sovereign gate tolls for a generation of dying miners.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot brokers a compromise treaty granting miners lifelong royalties in exchange for gate construction.
resolutions.summary: A perpetual royalty treaty is signed. {role:transit_consortium} builds the jump gate, funding lifelong medical care and dividends for {role:pioneer_league}.

resolutions.reached_by: The charter is suppressed or the pilot accepts the corporate bribe.
resolutions.summary: The ancient charter is declared void. {role:transit_consortium} evicts {role:pioneer_hollow} without compensation to complete the commercial jump gate.

loose_threads.detail: The wax seal on the fifty-year charter cylinder matches a colonial cartography bureau abolished three decades ago.
Jump corridor tariff futures surged forty percent on capital exchanges prior to the pioneer eviction notice.
A primary survey beacon in the asteroid basin shows fresh burn marks where someone tried to grind off coordinate stamps.

radio_hooks: Pioneer miners barricade asteroid basin claiming fifty-year colonial territorial sovereignty.
Transit consortium announces imminent ground-breaking for high-capacity jump gate corridor.
Colonial magistrate calls emergency arbitral hearing over conflicting sector charter coordinates.

voice_direction.elder_chairperson: Slow, defiant, and fierce. Uses antique maritime vernacular and pauses deliberately between sentences, refusing to repeat himself.
voice_direction.conglomerate_envoy: Brisk, corporate, and condescending. Speaks in smooth public relations buzzwords while treating historical claims as quaint nuisances.
